chatHistory.text:
Here is what I am starting with.

Starting request:
Physical Geology, a 14-lesson undergraduate course with weekly labs using hand-specimen kits. Lessons cover: introduction and earth systems; minerals and identification using Mohs hardness, streak, cleavage, and luster; silicate structures; igneous rocks and volcanism; sedimentary rocks and depositional environments; metamorphic rocks; the rock cycle; plate tectonics with a midterm exam covering minerals through metamorphic rocks; earthquakes and seismic waves; volcanic hazards; weathering and erosion; streams and groundwater; geologic time and relative dating; a field trip synthesis; and a comprehensive review with a final exam.
Got it. I will keep using that starting request while we build, check, and revise the course package.

promptText: Physical Geology, a 14-lesson undergraduate course with weekly labs using hand-specimen kits. Lessons cover: introduction and earth systems; minerals and identification using Mohs hardness, streak, cleavage, and luster; silicate structures; igneous rocks and volcanism; sedimentary rocks and depositional environments; metamorphic rocks; the rock cycle; plate tectonics with a midterm exam covering minerals through metamorphic rocks; earthquakes and seismic waves; volcanic hazards; weathering and erosion; streams and groundwater; geologic time and relative dating; a field trip synthesis; and a comprehensive review with a final exam.
